title: Finite-Support Dirichlet-Laplacian Optimality of Sine Windows vs. Truncated Gaussians
claims: The discrete sine window psi_sin*(x) = sqrt(2/(P+1)) sin(pi*(x+1)/(P+1)) is the exact ground-state eigenvector of the P x P Dirichlet Laplacian and globally maximizes unit-shift overlap gamma(1) = cos(pi/(P+1)) over all profiles supported on {0, ..., P-1}.
At unit shift Delta=1, gamma_box(1) < gamma_gauss(1) < gamma_sin*(1), while narrower truncated Gaussians achieve lower far-sidelobe QFT leakage outside |k| <= 2.
favorable_controls: P=16 and P=32 window comparisons (sine vs truncated Gaussian sigma=0.45*P vs box)
